title: Cape Breton Sailing Charters
specs: Anchor for a swim and lunch in a private cove.... then head out on the Bras d'Or for some invigorating open water sailing!

What to bring: Camera Bathing suit and towel (there may be a chance to swim) Food and beverages (BYOB), catering also available Cape Breton Sailing Charters / a division of Quadrant Property Development Inc.
Picnic lunch aboard – if there’s time, maybe a swim too.

services.name: Ocean & Inland Sea (2 days)
services.desc: Highlights: Steer the boat & handle the sails Experience the UNESCO Bras d’Or Lake Biosphere at sea level Amazing wildlife sightings at St Peter’s Inlet Pass through a historic tidal lock canal Try your sailing skills on the inland sea and on the Atlantic Ocean Rates: Private charter with Captain and crew for up to 4 people, accommodations aboard at Marina. 2 days sailing, 2 nights aboard. CA $2,250. plus HST You may add up to 2 additional day-sailing guests for $100/person/day. We will be happy to arrange or refer you to local overnight accommodations for day-sailing guests. Questions or further info? [Please email Captain Greg](mailto:captaingreg@capebretonsailing.com) Duration: 2 days
